summary: A stopped run no longer holds up the next one, and wizards can never overwrite your data by mistake.

fixes.title: Stopped runs no longer delay the next
fixes.text: After the platform stopped a run, the next runs waited up to 15 minutes. Now they take over at once.
fixes.action: Re-run the hosting access setup once so the scheduler can check its own runs.

fixes.title: Wizards never stage against an empty list
fixes.text: If a list failed to load, a wizard now says so and stages nothing, so your existing rows can never be replaced.

fixes.title: Drift shows hand-made roles in new areas
fixes.text: Areas you have not defined yet now list their live extras, marked "This area has no definitions yet". PIM Manager never removes them on its own.

fixes.title: Fuller Entra ID reference template
fixes.text: The template now has 76 groups and 168 role links, including 37 task groups and three more role groups.

fixes.title: Faster Home page
fixes.text: The Home page and the job history load faster.
